Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up-front, then items we can attach and one clarifying question:  

1) Detection vs confirmation: operationally we treat "detection" as the moment automated monitoring or a human flags anomalous activity. "Confirmation" is our triage result indicating a verified security incident (malicious activity, data exfiltration, or system compromise). We generally aim to complete initial triage (detection -> confirmation decision) within 4 hours for high-severity alerts, and 24 hours for lower-severity items.

2) Notification windows: once an incident is confirmed, Redwood's standard internal SLA is to notify affected customers within 72 hours for incidents with confirmed customer-data exposure. For incidents where customer data exposure is not confirmed but being investigated, we provide status updates at 24/48-hour cadence until resolution.

3) On-call contact: primary on-call is the Production Security Pager (rotating). Public POC for contractual notifications: David Kim (Security Ops Lead) — david_kim@redwood.example.com; +1-415-555-0179 (escalation line). We can supply the on-call roster CSV for your SIG pack; note we redact personal numbers for rotation members in shared artifacts, but provide the escalation line as above.

4) Region differences: we operate a single playbook with regional overlays. GDPR-related disclosures are coordinated with Legal and may require different notification content/timelines; we commit to the customer-relevant regulatory windows (we will not delay county/regional-required filings). APAC customers: some regulators expect faster acknowledgement windows — we will surface those on a per-case basis and list expected authorities in the final pack.

Attachments I can share now (redacted): 1) redwood_sig_ir_responses_v1.pdf (section excerpts: detection, triage, notification templates); 2) oncall_roster_nov2026.csv (redacted).

Clarifying Q: For the SIG, do you need a named engineer-level escalation contact (individual) or is the documented escalation line + Security Ops lead sufficient?

If you want an individual, we can provide a designated incident handler for GreenFinTech (TPA) to be on the call tree.

Regards,
